description.value: Pink Moon Cafe is a 100% plant-based food truck parked at GardenWorks Courtenay on Wentworth Road, serving the Comox Valley and Vancouver Island. The truck prioritizes sustainable, local, and organic ingredients and strikes a balance between health-conscious and comfort food. Every menu item is gluten-free or easily made gluten-free with simple substitutions, and online ordering for pickup or delivery is available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pink Moon Cafe is a 100% plant-based food truck stationed at GardenWorks Courtenay, 2855 Wentworth Rd. Phone and address match between OSM and website. The OSM opening_hours tag lists We-Su only, but the website states 7 days a week (Mon–Sun), a discrepancy flagged in concerns. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned on the website; the menu page confirms full vegan and gluten-free offerings, corroborating the OSM diet:vegan=yes tag.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists We-Su (Wednesday–Sunday) only, but the website states operation 7 days a week (Monday–Sunday). OSM tag should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active food truck with a confirmed address and operating website; publicly accessible and relevant to touring cyclists seeking plant-based food in the Comox Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Food truck is stationed at GardenWorks Courtenay garden centre; location may vary during special events — website recommends checking social media for daily location updates.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: 100% plant-based menu; website states all items are gluten-free or can be made gluten-free with simple substitutions
